text: The Bank of Canada held its overnight rate at 5.00%, noting that underlying inflation remains a concern. Fixed mortgage rates stayed near 5.5-6.0% for 5-year terms, keeping renewal payment shocks elevated for 2019-2021 originations.
title: Bank of Canada holds policy rate at 5.00%

text: OSFI confirmed the minimum qualifying rate framework remains in place. Borrowers renewing with a new lender must still qualify at the greater of the contract rate plus 2pp or 5.25%, which continues to suppress switching among uninsured borrowers with weaker credit.
title: OSFI confirms B-20 stress test unchanged for renewals switching lenders

text: The 5-year Government of Canada bond yield, the benchmark for fixed mortgage pricing, eased to 3.6% from 4.2% in late 2023. Lenders began trimming 5-year fixed posted rates, narrowing the gap between incumbent renewal offers and switcher discounts.
title: 5-year GoC bond yield eases to 3.6%

text: The Bank of Canada delivered its first cut of the cycle, lowering the overnight rate to 4.75% and signalling more easing if inflation continues to cool. Variable-rate mortgage holders saw immediate payment relief; discounting on variable terms intensified.
title: Bank of Canada cuts policy rate to 4.75%

text: A second consecutive 25bp cut brought the policy rate to 4.50%. Fixed-rate pricing barely moved, as bond markets had already priced the path, leaving the fixed-rate renewal shock largely intact for 2020-2021 low-rate cohorts.
title: Bank of Canada cuts to 4.50%

text: OSFI opened consultation on exempting straight switches of uninsured mortgages from the B-20 stress test at renewal. Lenders expect the change, if adopted, to lift switcher volumes materially among high-credit uninsured borrowers facing payment shock.
title: OSFI reviews renewal switching exemption for uninsured borrowers

text: The Bank accelerated easing with a 50bp cut to 3.75%, citing a softening labour market. The 5-year bond yield fell toward 3.0%, and lenders passed through roughly 40bp of the move into 5-year fixed specials, widening the switcher discount window.
title: Bank of Canada cuts to 3.75% in larger 50bp step

text: A further 50bp cut brought the policy rate to 3.25%. Variable-rate discounts widened to prime minus 0.90% at some lenders, making variable terms competitive again for borrowers willing to take rate risk at renewal.
title: Bank of Canada cuts to 3.25%

text: OSFI finalized the rule: uninsured borrowers with strong repayment history may switch lenders at renewal without re-qualifying under the stress test. Analysts expect a one-time uplift in switching propensity among 720+ credit-score borrowers.
title: OSFI finalizes stress-test exemption for straight switches

text: The policy rate reached 2.75% after a sixth consecutive cut. With 5-year fixed rates near 4.2%, the payment shock for 2021 low-rate renewals moderated from ~35% to ~20%, but remains the dominant switching driver.
title: Bank of Canada cuts to 2.75%

text: Trade-policy uncertainty pushed the 5-year bond yield back to 3.4%, and several lenders raised fixed rates by 15-25bp. The reversal narrowed the switcher discount just as the spring renewal wave peaked.
title: 5-year GoC bond yield climbs back to 3.4% on tariff worries

text: The Bank held at 2.75% and signalled a pause to assess tariff pass-through to inflation. Lenders expect fixed rates to stay range-bound through the summer renewal season, keeping switching incentives stable.
title: Bank of Canada holds at 2.75%, signals pause
